description: The email address format a company uses (e.g. {first}.{last}@acme.com), learned only from addresses that were verified deliverable, with each pattern's share and a confidence level. Free. Returns 'not published' when there is not yet enough verified evidence for the domain.

domain.description: Company website domain, e.g. acme.com (a full URL is accepted and reduced to its domain)
